riverparkvc-via-2-2fb20cbb-5525-40ba-98d.title: Engineering Manager
riverparkvc-via-2-2fb20cbb-5525-40ba-98d.description: Via is on a mission to create public transportation systems that provide far greater access to jobs, healthcare, and education. Our platform serves as the technology backbone for modern transit networks, transforming antiquated and siloed public transportation systems into smart, data-driven, and efficient digital networks. With hundreds of agency partners around the world, Via is recognized as the leading transportation technology and service provider globally. As an Engineering Manager at Via, you will oversee the development and maintenance of our backend systems that power our global transit platform. Via partners with cities and agencies around the world to improve mobility - especially for communities that rely on services such as paratransit and student transportation. You’ll combine technical leadership with hands-on engineering, helping shape both the architecture of our platform and the growth of the engineers on your team and supporting systems that impact hundreds of thousands of riders every week. About the Role: Grow and mentor high-performing engineers, creating a culture of ownership, learning, and technical excellence. Scale Via’s core backend systems to handle more riders, more drivers, and more real-time transit data - making our APIs and services faster, more reliable, and more efficient. Shape the architecture of our distributed systems, helping our platform evolve as we grow globally and handle more complex routing and operations. Roll up your sleeves and code when needed, helping debug tough production issues and making technical decisions alongside your team. Partner closely with cross-functional teams to turn challenging transit problems into real-world solutions - from routing systems to tools for paratransit and student transportation programs. Improve our engineering processes, from CI/CD practices to coding standards, making it easier to ship quickly while keeping our platform rock-solid. About You: You’ve spent 10+ years building backend systems, designing distributed, reliable, high-performance services. You’re strong in Python, Java, C++, or C# and confident in making technical decisions that scale. You’ve managed and developed engineering teams and understand how to grow talent. You know your way around cloud platforms (AWS), microservices, and Kubernetes, and can think through infrastructure challenges. You understand databases, performance tuning, and debugging complex systems inside and out. You love leading engineers while staying close to the technical details. You think in terms of systems and long-term impact, balancing reliability, performance, and speed. You’re a strong communicator, able to connect with engineers, product managers, and non-technical stakeholders alike. You thrive in an environment where you can make a difference, grow your team, and see the real-world impact of your work. Compensation and Benefits Final salary will be determined by the candidate’s experience, knowledge, and skills. Salary reflected does not include equity or variable pay, where applicable. Salary Range: $200,000 - $275,000 per year. We are proud to offer a generous and comprehensive benefits package, including free medical plans, 401K matching, catered lunch on Wednesdays, and many other perks. There has never been a more exciting time to be on the cutting edge of public mobility. Ready to join the ride? Via is an equal opportunity employer. #LI-CG2

uppartners-teleo:lever:26c8c2c3-37df-4db.title: Senior Autonomy Controls Engineer – Learning-Based Control
uppartners-teleo:lever:26c8c2c3-37df-4db.description: Teleo, a Havoc company, is a robotics company that transforms construction heavy equipment, including loaders, dozers, excavators, and trucks, into autonomous robots for commercial and defense applications. Our technology enables a single operator to supervise and control multiple machines simultaneously, delivering significant productivity gains while improving operator safety and comfort. Teleo was founded by a team of experienced technology leaders who previously led the development of Lyft's Self-Driving Car program and Google Street View. Teleo recently announced its merger with Havoc AI, a fast-growing defense technology company developing coordinated fleets of autonomous maritime vessels. This is a unique opportunity to join a team building technology with real-world impact. You will work on cutting-edge 100,000-pound autonomous robots and engineer complex systems at the intersection of hardware, software, robotics, and AI. About the Role Own the transition from manually tuned MPC-based vehicle control to learning-driven control policies that adapt across vehicles with minimal human intervention, while maintaining safety and interpretability.
responsibilities: Practical understanding of vehicle dynamics and system identification
Practical experience in generating test plans, collecting real-world data, and using real-world data for system identification of plant models for automatic control.
Design and implement learning-based control approaches (imitation learning, reinforcement learning, hybrid MPC + learning)
Reduce dependence on hand-tuned control parameters through data-driven methods
Integrate learned controllers into the existing vehicle control stack safely and incrementally
Define interfaces between classical control (MPC, PID, state estimation) and learning-based components
Work closely with the Principal Controls Engineer to translate classical control insights into learning-friendly formulations
Establish validation criteria for learned control policies before real-vehicle deployment
qualifications: 2-3 years of experience with experimental data collection and data analysis to estimate parameters of a plant model used for automatic control
Strong software engineering skills in C, C++, or Python (production-quality code)
Deep understanding of modern robotics control systems
Experience with learning-based control or policy optimization for real-world systems
Comfort working close to hardware and real-time constraints
Reinforcement learning or imitation learning for control
Model-based RL, residual learning, or hybrid MPC architectures
Control under uncertainty and partial observability
Debugging and validating control systems on physical platforms

xange-360learning:lever:705f8577-c37e-48.description: AI is central to 360Learning's strategy: our AI Squad ships agentic features that help users discover, create, and administrate content. You will join the AI Squad as its second AI Engineer, working closely with 1 peer AI Engineer, 1 Product Manager, 1 Product Designer, and 4 Full-Stack Developers.
